text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Did it just... run away from us?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして……
逃げてったッスか？

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, I was just getting started!
You can't leave me hanging like this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいおい、
まだこれからだろ？
これじゃ不完全燃焼だぜ。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text:
There's a hole over here.
This must be where the creature escaped.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっちに抜け穴があるね。
どうやら
ここから逃げたみたいだ。

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... Do we have to go after it?
I've got a bad feeling about this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう、
本当に行く気ですか？
嫌な予感がするですよ……
